task: Disambiguate story_review numeric PLAN review rounds from signed artifact reviewRound strings.

facts: Signed finding and review pass reviewRound is story.currentReviewRound, an ISO 8601 string.
story_review currently returns reviewRound: reviewData.reviews.length as a numeric PLAN review count.

rg found no existing smoke asserting story_review.reviewRound directly; only the handler currently emits the ambiguous numeric field.
constraints: Do not break existing story_review consumers abruptly; preserve a compatibility alias if the old field is public.
